verdict.rationale: sevDesk lets users assign invoices and receipts to cost centres, then filter and analyse income and expenses by cost centre. That is a single class-like dimension for analysis, but it is not a custom report builder covering multiple dimensions. Missing for 10: a custom report builder, location and tag dimensions, grouping across several dimensions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can build custom reports filtered and grouped by class, location, or tag dimensions

citations.quote: Assign invoices and receipts to different cost centres. You can then filter by cost centre and analyse the income and expenses assigned to each one.
